title: 情境對話
description: 模擬真實生活中的英語對話場景

dialogues.text: Hi, welcome to Joe's Diner! How many people?
dialogues.textZh: 嗨，歡迎來到喬的餐廳！請問幾位？

dialogues.text: Table for two, please.
Sure, right this way. Here's the menu.
Can I see the menu, please?
Are you ready to order?
Yes, I'll have the steak, please.
How would you like your steak? Rare, medium, or well-done?
dialogues.textZh: 您的牛排要幾分熟？一分熟、五分熟還是全熟？

dialogues.text: Medium, please. And a side of mashed potatoes.
dialogues.textZh: 五分熟。还要一份馬鈴薯泥。

dialogues.text: Would you like anything to drink?
I'll have a glass of red wine.
Great. That'll be all?
Yes, that's all. Thank you.
Here you go. Enjoy your meal!
The check, please.
Here you are. That'll be $45.50.
Keep the change. Thank you!

scenarios.name: 電話禮貌

dialogues.text: Hello, may I speak to Mr. Smith, please?
dialogues.textZh: 您好，請問史密斯先生在嗎？

dialogues.text: This is he. Who's this?
This is John from ABC Company. Is he available?
dialogues.textZh: 我是 ABC 公司的約翰。請問他有空嗎？

dialogues.text: May I ask who's calling?
This is John. It's regarding the meeting tomorrow.
dialogues.textZh: 我是約翰。關於明天會議的事。

dialogues.text: One moment, please. I'll transfer you.
Thank you very much.
I'm sorry, the line is busy. Can I take a message?
dialogues.textZh: 抱歉，線路忙中。可以留言嗎？

dialogues.text: Yes, please tell him John called. He can reach me at 0912-345-678.
dialogues.textZh: 好的，請告訴他約翰打過電話。可以打 0912-345-678 給我。

dialogues.text: Got it. I'll make sure he gets the message.
dialogues.textZh: 收到了，我會確保他收到訊息。

dialogues.text: Thank you. Have a nice day!
You too. Goodbye!

keyPhrases: I'll have him call you back.

dialogues.text: Excuse me, how much is this?
Do you have this in other colors?
Yes, we have it in blue, red, and black.
Can I try this on?
Of course. The fitting room is over there.
dialogues.textZh: 當然可以。更衣室在那邊。

dialogues.text: This fits great! I'll take it.
Great! Would you like a bag?
Yes, please. Do you accept credit cards?
dialogues.textZh: 要的。請問接受信用卡嗎？

dialogues.text: Yes, we take all major credit cards.
Is there a discount if I pay cash?
Sorry, we don't offer cash discounts.
No problem. I'll pay by card.
Please sign here. Here's your receipt.
dialogues.textZh: 請在這裡簽名。這是您的收據。

dialogues.text: Thank you! Have a nice day!

scenarios.name: 社交閒聊

dialogues.text: Hi there! Nice to meet you. I'm Sarah.
dialogues.textZh: 嗨！很高興認識你，我是莎拉。

dialogues.text: Nice to meet you too, Sarah. I'm John.
dialogues.textZh: 也很高興認識你，莎拉。我是約翰。

dialogues.text: So, what do you do for a living?
I'm a software engineer. How about you?
I work in marketing. It's pretty exciting!
dialogues.textZh: 我在行銷部門工作，很刺激！

dialogues.text: That sounds interesting! How long have you been doing that?
dialogues.textZh: 聽起來很有趣！你做這行多久了？

dialogues.text: About 5 years now. Time flies!
dialogues.textZh: 大概 5 年了。時間過得真快！

dialogues.text: I hear that. So, how do you like working here?
dialogues.textZh: 說得也是。你在這裡工作得怎麼樣？

dialogues.text: It's great! The people are really friendly.
dialogues.textZh: 很好！這裡的人都非常友善。

dialogues.text: That's awesome! Hey, it was great talking to you.
dialogues.textZh: 太棒了！嘿，很高興和你聊天。

dialogues.text: Likewise! Let's grab coffee sometime.
dialogues.textZh: 我也是！找時間一起喝咖啡吧。

dialogues.text: Sounds good! Here's my card. Give me a call.
dialogues.textZh: 好啊！這是我的名片，打給我。

keyPhrases: What do you do for a living?

scenarios.name: 問路

dialogues.text: Excuse me, could you help me?
Sure, what do you need?
I'm looking for the train station. Is it far from here?
dialogues.textZh: 我在找火車站。離這裡遠嗎？

dialogues.text: Not really. It's just a 5-minute walk.
dialogues.textZh: 不遠，走 5 分鐘就到了。

dialogues.text: Great! Which way should I go?
Go straight down this street, then turn left at the second traffic light.
dialogues.textZh: 沿著這條街直走，然後在第二個紅綠燈左轉。

dialogues.text: Turn left at the second light. Got it!
dialogues.textZh: 第二個紅綠燈左轉，知道了！

dialogues.text: You'll see it on your right. You can't miss it.
dialogues.textZh: 你會在右手邊看到，不會錯過的。

dialogues.text: Thank you so much!
No problem. Have a nice day!

keyPhrases: Excuse me, could you help me?
